module.name: Nidan Clinical Documents
module.author: Dipak Thapa
module.description: Captures an immutable rendition of a clinician's narrative when an encounter is finalised, and stores it as an Attachment. O3 prints these client-side and stores nothing, so without this there is no artifact for the Odoo document desk, the insurance claim packet or the patient portal to fetch.

globalProperty.description: Master switch. Off by default: writing a permanent clinical document is something a site should turn on deliberately, not something that starts happening because a module was installed.
Render after the transaction commits rather than inside it. Off only for testing: rendering a PDF inside saveEncounter puts that latency in front of a clinician signing a note.
